title: Resilient Monitoring of Social Dynamical Systems through Collaborative Multi-Agent Networks under Latency
summary: Social dynamical networks significantly influence contemporary digital landscapes, affecting realms from social activism to public policy formulation. This paper investigates the use of multi-agent systems (MAS) to monitor and analyze these networks. Firstly, we propose a single-time-scale distributed inference model designed to effectively manage challenges such as latency and agent failure.
